Author: AzeraKih
Name: Duty Roulette Logger
Description: A Dalamud (FFXIV Quick Launcher) plugin that records every roullete run (entry, exit, duration, party, role, status) to a SQLite database, with a filterable, sortable history window that can be exported to CSV. non roulette runs are not logged
Punchline: Automatic roulette run history with a SQLite database
